LESSON: CLEANING THE HOUSE

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: HOME SCIENCE
Strand: Home Management
Topic 2.4: Cleaning the House
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 14

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Cleaning the House, part of Home Management in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10 HOME SCIENCE.

Key inquiry question: How can we care for our house? 2. How does the type of dirt influence the method of cleaning the house?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. discuss and present in class ways of cleaning the house (removal of loose and fixed dirt). Learners with speech difficulties could use alternative communication modes as they share their views on causes of accidents,

2. use digital or print media to search for information on materials and equipment used for cleaning the house - type, choice, use and care (such as brooms, dusters, dustpan, brushes, mops, basins, buckets, vacuum cleaner, squeegee). Learners with manipulation difficulties could use adapted digital devices with appropriate accessibility features. Screen resolutions could be adjusted for learners who are sensitive to light and colour, 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. discuss and present in class ways of cleaning the house (removal of loose and fixed dirt). Learners with speech difficulties could use alternative communication modes as they share their views on causes of accidents,
2. use digital or print media to search for information on materials and equipment used for cleaning the house - type, choice, use and care (such as brooms, dusters, dustpan, brushes, mops, basins, buckets, vacuum cleaner, squeegee). Learners with manipulation difficulties could use adapted digital devices with appropriate accessibility features. Screen resolutions could be adjusted for learners who are sensitive to light and colour, 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Cleaning the House together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and Collaboration: The learner speaks clearly as they discuss and present in class reasons for cleaning the

house.

● Learning to Learn: Learners reflect on their own work after cleaning after cleaning various rooms in the house using

appropriate methods.

Values:
● Integrity: The learner applies laid down procedures when cleaning different rooms within the house using appropriate

methods.

● Social justice: Learners share cleaning materials and tools equitably when cleaning different rooms within the

school/house.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Environmental conservation: Learners use locally available resources to make cleaning equipment and materials.
